classification_vocabulary.deferred_with_reason: Canonical source identity retained with reason, owner, replacement condition and recheck point.
classification_vocabulary.in_scope: Canonical source identity consumed by T15-T18 or an already closed slice; this is not an implementation claim.
classification_vocabulary.out_of_scope: Compatibility or gameplay axis explicitly excluded from the third-stage machine/energy batches.
classification_vocabulary.unclassified: No reviewed disposition exists; any occurrence blocks readiness.

normalization.declared_transformation: Registrations differing only by material, input window, parallel, efficiency/output/capacity tier values or source tier index are variants. Behavior class, process map, accepted/emitted energy and policy flags never collapse.
